items.title: 6.5.3 Tangents and Normals to Hyperbola (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 206-209: 6.5.3 intersection of line and hyperbola, Tangency Condition, Points of Contact, Examples 27 and 28

blocks.text: Bachon, circle, parabola aur ellipse mein aap tangent aur normal parh chuke hain. Ab yahi kaam hyperbola ke liye karte hain. Tangent (mamaas) woh line hai jo curve ko sirf ek jagah chhooti hai, aur normal woh line hai jo usi point par tangent par perpendicular ho. Tareeqa wahi purana hai: line ki equation ko curve ki equation mein rakho, ek quadratic equation banegi, aur us ke roots batayenge ke line curve ko kitni jagah milti hai. Agar dono roots barabar hon to line sirf chhooti hai, yani tangent hai. Socho ek seedhi chhari ko gol pathar ke saath lagate hain: thora andar karein to do jagah lagti hai, thora bahar to kahin nahi lagti, aur theek beech wali halat mein sirf ek jagah chhooti hai. Yahi tangent hai.

Humare paas hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ...(1)
aur line \(y = mx + c\) ...(2) hai.
Hum dono ke milne ke points (points of intersection) aur tangent hone ki shart (condition for tangency) dhoondna chahte hain. Is ke liye \(y = mx + c\) ko hyperbola ki equation mein rakhte hain:
\[\dfrac{x^2}{a^2} - \dfrac{(mx + c)^2}{b^2} = 1\]

Denominators khatam karne ke liye dono taraf \(a^2b^2\) se multiply karte hain: \(b^2x^2 - a^2(mx + c)^2 = a^2b^2\)
Ab bracket kholte hain aur sab terms ek taraf le aate hain:
\[b^2x^2 - a^2(m^2x^2 + 2mcx + c^2) = a^2b^2\]
\[b^2x^2 - a^2m^2x^2 - 2a^2mcx\]
\[\quad - a^2c^2 - a^2b^2 = 0\]
\[(b^2 - a^2m^2)x^2 - 2a^2mcx\]
\[\quad - a^2(c^2 + b^2) = 0 \quad \text{...(3)}\]

Yeh \(x\) mein quadratic equation hai; is ke roots un points ke \(x\)-coordinates hain jahan line aur hyperbola milte hain. Har \(x\) ko \(y = mx + c\) mein rakhne se us ka \(y\) mil jata hai. Is tarah line aur hyperbola zyada se zyada do points par milte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai 'do points par milte hain'; isay 'zyada se zyada do points' samjhiye. Equation (3) ke do real roots ho sakte hain (line curve ko do jagah kaat-ti hai), ek dohra root (line sirf chhooti hai, yani tangent), ya koi real root nahi (line curve se bilkul alag guzarti hai). Ek khaas soorat aur: agar \(b^2 - a^2m^2 = 0\), yani \(m = \pm\frac{b}{a}\) (asymptote ke parallel line), to (3) quadratic hi nahi rehti aur line curve ko zyada se zyada ek point par milti hai. Isi liye tangent ki shart discriminant se nikalti hai.
Tangency Condition

Tangent tab hoti hai jab \(x\) wali quadratic ke dono roots barabar hon, yani discriminant \(D = 0\). Yaad kijiye, \(Ax^2 + Bx + C = 0\) ka discriminant \(B^2 - 4AC\) hota hai. Yahan \(A = b^2 - a^2m^2\), \(B = -2a^2mc\), \(C = -a^2(c^2 + b^2)\):
\[(-2a^2mc)^2\]
\[- 4(b^2 - a^2m^2)[-a^2(c^2 + b^2)] = 0\]
\[4a^4m^2c^2\]
\[\quad + 4a^2(b^2 - a^2m^2)(c^2 + b^2) = 0\]

Dono terms mein \(4a^2\) common hai, use bahar nikaalte hain:
\[4a^2[a^2m^2c^2\]
\[\quad + (b^2 - a^2m^2)(c^2 + b^2)] = 0\]

Kyun ke \(a \ne 0\), is liye bracket hi zero hoga:
\[a^2m^2c^2 + (b^2 - a^2m^2)(c^2 + b^2) = 0\]

Doosre term ko kholte hain; dekhiye \(a^2m^2c^2\) aur \(-a^2m^2c^2\) cancel ho jate hain:
\[a^2m^2c^2 + b^2c^2 + b^4\]
\[\quad - a^2m^2c^2 - a^2m^2b^2 = 0\]
\[-a^2m^2b^2 + b^2c^2 + b^4 = 0\]

Dono taraf \(b^2\) se divide karte hain \((b \ne 0)\):
\[-a^2m^2 + c^2 + b^2 = 0\]
Yani tangent hone ki shart yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: c squared equals a squared m squared minus b squared, so c equals plus or minus the square root of a squared m squared minus b squared, provided a squared m squared is greater than b squared

blocks.text: bashart-e-ke \(a^2m^2 > b^2\), taa ke root ke andar positive number ho.
\(c\) ki yeh value \(y = mx + c\) mein rakhne se \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) milta hai: har us slope \(m\) ke liye do tangents jis ke liye \(a^2m^2 > b^2\), yani \(|m| > \frac{b}{a}\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke yeh do tangents "for all values of \(m\)" hain. Yeh sahi nahi: \(\sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) sirf tab real aur ghair-sifar hai jab \(a^2m^2 > b^2\), yani \(|m| > \frac{b}{a}\), jaisa kitab ne khud ek line pehle likha. \(|m| \le \frac{b}{a}\) ke liye slope \(m\) wali koi tangent nahi hoti (\(|m| = \frac{b}{a}\) par lines \(y = \pm\frac{b}{a}x\) asymptotes hain, tangents nahi).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Tangent ki slope asymptote se zyada tez (steep) kyun honi chahiye? Tangent ek branch ko chhoo kar us ke bahar rehti hai, aur branches asymptotes ke darmiyan khulti hain. Is liye chhoone wali line ko asymptotes se zyada khari hona parta hai. Muqabla kijiye: ellipse mein \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) har \(m\) ke liye chalta tha, kyun ke ellipse band curve hai aur har simt mein us ki tangent hoti hai. Hyperbola mein minus sign \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\) slope par pabandi laga deta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{9} - \frac{y^2}{4} = 1\) ki slope \(\frac{1}{2}\) wali tangent ho sakti hai? Asymptotes ki slope \(\pm\frac{2}{3} \approx \pm 0.67\) hai. \(\frac{1}{2} < \frac{2}{3}\), is liye nahi: \(a^2m^2 - b^2 = \frac{9}{4} - 4 < 0\), root imaginary. Magar slope 1 ki tangent mumkin hai: \(c^2 = 9 - 4 = 5\), tangents \(y = x \pm \sqrt{5}\).
Points of Contact

Line \(y = mx + c\) hyperbola ko jin points par kaat-ti hai, un ke \(x\) quadratic \((b^2 - a^2m^2)x^2 - 2a^2mcx - a^2(c^2 + b^2) = 0\) ko quadratic formula se hal kar ke milte hain:
\[x = \dfrac{-(-2a^2mc) \pm \sqrt{D}}{2(b^2 - a^2m^2)}\]
\[D = (2a^2mc)^2\]
\[\quad - 4(b^2 - a^2m^2)\cdot(-a^2(c^2 + b^2))\]
\[= 4a^4m^2c^2\]
\[\quad + 4a^2(b^2 - a^2m^2)(c^2 + b^2)\]
\[x = \dfrac{2a^2mc \pm \sqrt{D}}{2(b^2 - a^2m^2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{a^2mc \pm \sqrt{E}}{b^2 - a^2m^2}\]
\[E = \tfrac{1}{4}D = a^4m^2c^2\]
\[\quad + a^2(b^2 - a^2m^2)(c^2 + b^2)\]
Aur \(y\)-coordinates \(y = mx + c\) se milte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ab chhoone ka point (point of contact) khud nikaalte hain (yeh hamari taraf se izafa hai). Tangent ki soorat mein discriminant zero hai, is liye \(\pm\sqrt{\ \ }\) wala hissa khatam ho jata hai aur dono roots ek ban jate hain. Tangency condition se \(b^2 - a^2m^2 = -c^2\), to:
\[x = \dfrac{a^2mc}{b^2 - a^2m^2} = \dfrac{a^2mc}{-c^2} = -\dfrac{a^2m}{c}\]
\[y = mx + c = \dfrac{-a^2m^2 + c^2}{c} = -\dfrac{b^2}{c}\]
Yani tangent \(y = mx + c\) hyperbola ko \(\left(-\frac{a^2m}{c}, -\frac{b^2}{c}\right)\) par chhooti hai. Tasdeeq: \(\frac{a^2m^2}{c^2} - \frac{b^2}{c^2} = \frac{a^2m^2 - b^2}{c^2} = 1\), sahi.

Ab do misaalen. Pehli mein hum curve ke kisi bhi point \((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent aur normal ka aam formula nikalenge; yeh formula aage exercise mein bahut kaam aayega. Doosri mein ek bahar wale point se tangents khenchenge, jahan upar wali tangency condition istemal hogi.

blocks.title: Example 27
blocks.problem: Find equation of the tangent and normal to the hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) at the point \((x_1, y_1)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) aur us par point \((x_1, y_1)\).
Maloom karna: \((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent aur normal ki equations.
Tareeqa: implicit differentiation se tangent ki slope, point-slope form se tangent; normal tangent par perpendicular hota hai, is liye us ki slope \(-\frac{1}{m}\).

Tangent ki slope
Hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ko \(x\) ke lihaaz se implicitly differentiate karte hain:
\[\dfrac{2x}{a^2} - \dfrac{2y}{b^2}\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 0\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{b^2}{a^2} \cdot \dfrac{x}{y}\]
Point \((x_1, y_1)\) par slope: \(\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)_{(x_1, y_1)} = \frac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1}\).
Kyun: \(y\) bhi \(x\) par munhasir hai, is liye \(y^2\) ka derivative chain rule se \(2y\frac{dy}{dx}\) hai. Derivative kisi point par tangent ki slope deta hai.

Tangent ki equation
\[y - y_1 = \dfrac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1}(x - x_1)\]
Dono taraf \(\frac{y_1}{b^2}\) se multiply:
\[\dfrac{yy_1}{b^2} - \dfrac{y_1^2}{b^2} = \dfrac{xx_1}{a^2} - \dfrac{x_1^2}{a^2}\]
Tarteeb dene par:
\[\dfrac{xx_1}{a^2} - \dfrac{yy_1}{b^2} = \dfrac{x_1^2}{a^2} - \dfrac{y_1^2}{b^2}\]
Kyun: point-slope form lagayi; \(\frac{y_1}{b^2}\) se multiply karne se right side ka fraction saaf ho gaya aur dono taraf ek jaisi shakal aa gayi.

Point curve par hai, is baat ka faida
\((x_1, y_1)\) hyperbola par hai, is liye \(\frac{x_1^2}{a^2} - \frac{y_1^2}{b^2} = 1\). To tangent ki equation:
\[\dfrac{xx_1}{a^2} - \dfrac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\]
Kyun: right side bilkul hyperbola ki equation hai jis mein \((x_1, y_1)\) rakha gaya, aur woh 1 ke barabar hai.
Dhyan dein: yaad rakhne ki trick: \(x^2\) ki jagah \(xx_1\) aur \(y^2\) ki jagah \(yy_1\) likh do.

Normal ki slope
Ab point \((x_1, y_1)\) par normal ki equation:
Normal ki slope \(-\frac{a^2y_1}{b^2x_1}\) hai.
Kyun: normal tangent par perpendicular hai, is liye slope tangent ki slope \(\frac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1}\) ka negative reciprocal hai: fraction ulta karo aur sign badlo.

Normal ki equation
\[y - y_1 = -\dfrac{a^2y_1}{b^2x_1}(x - x_1)\]
Dono taraf \(b^2x_1\) se multiply: \(b^2x_1y - b^2x_1y_1 = -a^2y_1x + a^2x_1y_1\)
Tarteeb:
\[a^2y_1x + b^2x_1y = x_1y_1(a^2 + b^2)\]
Dono taraf \(x_1y_1\) se divide (jab \(x_1 \ne 0\), \(y_1 \ne 0\)):
\[\dfrac{a^2x}{x_1} + \dfrac{b^2y}{y_1} = a^2 + b^2\]
Kyun: \(x\) aur \(y\) wale terms left par aur constants right par jama kiye; \(x_1y_1\) se divide karne par yaad rakhne mein aasaan shakal mil gayi.
Dhyan dein: tangent mein beech mein minus hai, magar normal mein plus aur right side par \(a^2 + b^2\).

Tasdeeq:
Tangent \((x_1, y_1)\) se guzarta hai: \(\frac{x_1^2}{a^2} - \frac{y_1^2}{b^2} = 1\), sahi. Normal bhi: \(a^2 + b^2 = a^2 + b^2\), sahi. Slopes ka hasil-e-zarb: \(\frac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1} \times \left(-\frac{a^2y_1}{b^2x_1}\right) = -1\), yani dono perpendicular hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "equation of normal at \((x - y_1)\)" chhapa hai. Sahi "at \((x_1, y_1)\)" hai, yani hyperbola ka diya hua point.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 27 ka formula \(\frac{x^2}{16} - \frac{y^2}{9} = 1\) ke point \((5, \frac{9}{4})\) par lagaiye. Pehle check: \(\frac{25}{16} - \frac{81}{144} = \frac{25}{16} - \frac{9}{16} = 1\), point curve par hai. Tangent: \(\frac{5x}{16} - \frac{y}{4} = 1\), yani \(5x - 4y = 16\). Normal: \(\frac{16x}{5} + \frac{9y}{9/4} = 25\), yani \(\frac{16x}{5} + 4y = 25\).

blocks.title: Example 28
blocks.problem: Find the equations of the tangents to the hyperbola \(2x^2 - 3y^2 = 24\) that pass through the point \((2, -4)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: hyperbola \(2x^2 - 3y^2 = 24\) aur point \((2, -4)\).
Maloom karna: \((2, -4)\) se guzarne wale tangents.
Tareeqa: hyperbola ko standard form mein laana, phir slope wali tangent \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) lena aur use \((2, -4)\) se guzaar kar \(m\) nikaalna.

Standard form
Dono taraf 24 se divide:
\[\dfrac{x^2}{12} - \dfrac{y^2}{8} = 1\]
Yani \(a^2 = 12\), \(b^2 = 8\).
Kyun: tangency ki shart \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) wali shakal ke liye nikali gayi thi; pehle equation ko usi shakal mein laana zaroori hai.

Slope \(m\) wali tangent
\(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ki slope \(m\) wali tangent: \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\). \(a^2 = 12\), \(b^2 = 8\) rakhein:
\[y = mx \pm \sqrt{12m^2 - 8}\]
Kyun: yeh 6.5.3 ki tangency condition \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\) hai.

\((2, -4)\) se guzaarna
\(x = 2\), \(y = -4\) rakhein:
\[-4 = 2m \pm \sqrt{12m^2 - 8}\]
\[-4 - 2m = \pm\sqrt{12m^2 - 8}\]
Kyun: matlooba tangent diye hue point se guzarna chahiye; is shart se \(m\) ki equation banti hai.

Square kar ke \(m\) nikaalna
\[16 + 16m + 4m^2 = 12m^2 - 8\]
\[8m^2 - 16m - 24 = 0\]
\[m^2 - 2m - 3 = 0\]
\[(m - 3)(m + 1) = 0 \Rightarrow m = 3 \text{ ya } m = -1\]
Kyun: square karne se root aur \(\pm\) dono khatam ho gaye; phir 8 se divide kar ke factorise kiya.
Dhyan dein: \((-4 - 2m)^2 = 16 + 16m + 4m^2\); minus ka square plus hota hai.

\(m = 3\) ke liye
\[y = 3x \pm \sqrt{12(9) - 8} = 3x \pm \sqrt{100}\]
\[y = 3x \pm 10\]
Kaun sa sign point \((2, -4)\) ko satisfy karta hai?
\(y = 3x + 10\): \(x = 2\) par \(y = 16\), to \((2, -4)\) is par nahi.
\(y = 3x - 10\): \(x = 2\) par \(y = -4\), to \((2, -4)\) is par hai.
Tangent: \(3x - y - 10 = 0\).
Kyun: square karne se dono sign aa gaye the, magar har slope ke liye sirf ek line diye hue point se guzarti hai.

\(m = -1\) ke liye
\[y = -x \pm \sqrt{12(1) - 8} = -x \pm \sqrt{4}\]
\[y = -x \pm 2\]
\(y = -x + 2\): \(x = 2\) par \(y = 0\), to \((2, -4)\) is par nahi.
\(y = -x - 2\): \(x = 2\) par \(y = -4\), to \((2, -4)\) is par hai.
Tangent: \(x + y + 2 = 0\).
Kyun: wahi sign wali jaanch.

Tasdeeq:
\(3x - y - 10 = 0\) ke liye \(c^2 = 100\) aur \(a^2m^2 - b^2 = 12 \cdot 9 - 8 = 100\). \(x + y + 2 = 0\) ke liye \(c^2 = 4\) aur \(12 \cdot 1 - 8 = 4\). Dono tangency ki shart poori karte hain aur dono \((2, -4)\) se guzarte hain. Point \((2, -4)\) curve ke bahar hai (\(\frac{4}{12} - \frac{16}{8} < 1\)), is liye do tangents hi aane chahiye the.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Bahar wale point se tangents ke sawal mein teen qadam yaad rakhiye: (1) equation ko standard form mein laao aur \(a^2\), \(b^2\) parho; (2) point ko \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) mein rakh kar \(m\) ki quadratic hal karo; (3) har \(m\) ke liye sirf woh sign rakho jis wali line diye hue point se guzarti hai. Teesra qadam bahut se students bhool jate hain aur chaar lines likh dete hain, jin mein se do ghalat hoti hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{9} - \frac{y^2}{16} = 1\) ki woh tangents nikaaliye jin ki slope 2 ho. Pehle shart check: asymptotes ki slope \(\frac{4}{3} \approx 1.33\) hai aur \(2 > 1.33\), is liye tangents mumkin hain. \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2 = 9 \cdot 4 - 16 = 20\), to \(c = \pm 2\sqrt{5}\) aur tangents \(y = 2x \pm 2\sqrt{5}\). Chhoone ke points: \(c = 2\sqrt{5}\) ke liye \(\left(-\frac{18}{2\sqrt{5}}, -\frac{16}{2\sqrt{5}}\right) = \left(-\frac{9}{\sqrt{5}}, -\frac{8}{\sqrt{5}}\right)\). Tasdeeq: \(\frac{81/5}{9} - \frac{64/5}{16} = \frac{9}{5} - \frac{4}{5} = 1\), sahi.

Ek nazar peeche: is poore section ka khulasa ek jumle mein yeh hai ke 'tangent = barabar roots'. Line ko curve mein rakho, quadratic banao, discriminant zero karo. Isi ek usool se tangency condition nikli, isi se chhoone ka point, aur Example 28 mein bahar ke point se tangents. Example 27 mein humne doosra rasta liya, yani differentiation, jo curve ke kisi diye hue point par tangent ke liye sab se aasaan hai. Dono raste ek hi jawab dete hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Line \(y = mx + c\) ko hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) mein rakho to \(x\) ki quadratic banti hai.
2. Tangent \(\iff\) discriminant zero \(\iff c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\), jahan \(a^2m^2 > b^2\).
3. Slope \(m\) wali tangents: \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\); chhoone ka point \(\left(-\frac{a^2m}{c}, -\frac{b^2}{c}\right)\).
4. \((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent: \(\frac{xx_1}{a^2} - \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\).
5. \((x_1, y_1)\) par normal: \(\frac{a^2x}{x_1} + \frac{b^2y}{y_1} = a^2 + b^2\).
6. Bahar wale point se tangents: point rakho, \(m\) nikaalo, sahi sign chuno.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Hyperbola ke liye ellipse wali shart \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) laga dena. Hyperbola: \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\).
2. Pehle equation ko \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ki shakal mein na laana (Example 28 mein \(a^2 = 12\), \(b^2 = 8\) hain, 2 aur 3 nahi).
3. \(y = 3x \pm 10\) ki dono lines jawab mein likh dena; sirf woh chahiye jo diye hue point se guzre.
4. Normal mein bhi tangent ki tarah minus likh dena; normal \(\frac{a^2x}{x_1} + \frac{b^2y}{y_1} = a^2 + b^2\) hai.
5. \(-4 - 2m\) ka square karte hue sign ki ghalti: \((-4 - 2m)^2 = 16 + 16m + 4m^2\).
